dct_title_s: Damage assessment along the Sebaya River, Rubavu and Karongi Districts, Western Province, Rwanda. - 6 May 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230504RWA, GDACS Id: 1101977** This map illustrates satellite-based damage assessment along the Sebaya River, Rubavu and Karongi Districts, Western Province, Rwanda detected by using a Pleiades very high resolution satellite image acquired on 6 May 2023. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT identified 355 affected and potentially affected structures. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
